description: This C# source file defines a static class 'DbConstantsStore' and related classes that manage database-specific constants and capabilities in the Orleans project. It includes mappings for various database providers like SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle, detailing their escape characters, support for streaming and command cancellation, and other database-specific behaviors. The file uses conditional compilation to define namespaces based on different build configurations.

classes.name: DbConstantsStore
classes.description: A static class providing database-specific constants and capability queries, tailored for different database providers via a dictionary and extension methods.

classes.name: DbConstants
classes.description: A class encapsulating various database capabilities and settings such as escape characters, support for streaming and cancellation, and command interception.

methods.name: GetDbConstants
methods.description: Retrieves the DbConstants instance corresponding to a given database provider invariant name.

methods.name: SupportsCommandCancellation
methods.description: Checks if the specified or stored database supports command cancellation.

methods.name: SupportsStreamNatively
methods.description: Checks if the specified or stored database supports streaming natively.

methods.name: IsSynchronousAdoNetImplementation
methods.description: Determines if the ADO.NET implementation for a given or stored database is synchronous.

methods.name: GetDatabaseCommandInterceptor
methods.description: Returns the command interceptor associated with a specific database provider.
